import sys

MOD = 998244353

def power(x, y, p):
    res = 1
    x = x % p
    while y > 0:
        if y & 1:
            res = (res * x) % p
        y >>= 1
        x = (x * x) % p
    return res

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input_data[0])
    m = int(input_data[1])
    l = int(input_data[2])
    r = int(input_data[3])
    k = n * m
    length = r - l + 1

    if k % 2 == 1:
        result = power(length, n * m, MOD)
        print(result)
        return

    ans = (power(length, k, MOD) + power(length % 2, k, MOD)) * power(2, MOD - 2, MOD) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
